summary: Fix stale/illustrative Example fields on drive.go, episode.go, and scenes.go (parent Cobra dispatcher commands) that were independently live-dogfood-tested and failed with non-existent placeholder paths, even though their child commands were correctly annotated and passing.
reason: The live dogfood matrix mechanically tests every command with a declared Example field, parent or child; a parent's own illustrative (non-working) Example fails as a real invocation regardless of the child's pp:happy-args.
